title: Contributing to containr
text: containr wraps system commands (podman, docker) tested end--end without running container daemon, real images, , push_image(), live registry. test suite addresses three-layer strategy. Layer 1 – Argument validation. Pure R checks bad arguments error correctly required arguments enforced. tests run every platform, including CRAN, external dependencies. Mocked bindings intercept internal container checks tests can run without Podman Docker installed. Layer 3 – Integration.
